puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ, suvānehi vā khajjamānaṃ, sigālehi vā khajjamānaṃ, vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ.

taṃ tattha suvānadoṇiyaṃ suvānapiṇḍam'iva dantamusalehi koṭṭetvā jivhāya samparivattiyamānaṃ jivh'āgge tanupasannakheḷo makkheti, vemajjhato paṭṭhāya bahalakheḷo makkheti, dantakaṭṭhena asampattaṭṭhāne dantagūthako makkheti.
tattha yathā paramajegucchāya suvānadoṇiyā ṭhito suvānavamathu na jānāti ahaṃ suvānadoṇiyā ṭhito'ti, na'pi suvānadoṇi jānāti mayi suvānavamathu ṭhito'ti.

taṃ tattha suvānadoṇiyaṃ suvānapiṇḍam'iva dantamusalehi koṭṭetvā jivhāya samparivattiyamānaṃ jivh'āgge tanupasannakheḷo makkheti, vemajjhato paṭṭhāya bahalakheḷo makkheti, dantakaṭṭhena asampattaṭṭhāne dantagūthako makkheti.

64597.commentary: (SNa) n'āvattena suvānayo'ti na kodh'āvattena suānayo, kodhavase vattetuṃ na sukaro'mhī'ti vadati.

examples.text: arahaṃ sugato loke, na rāgena suvānayo, māradheyyaṃ atikkanto, tasmā socām'ahaṃ bhusan'ti.

64599.meaning1: neatly arranged; well ordered; neatly trimmed
64599.commentary: (UDa) ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā'ti niyak'ajjhattasaṅkhāte attano santāne uppajjan'ārahā suvikappitā suṭṭhu vikappitā asesato, kiñci'pi asesetvā susamucchinnā'ti attho.

examples.text: yassa vitakkā vidhūpitā, ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
